rows.ARS:
Yellow blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: FRYjingo
rows.Origin: Bred by Gareth Fryer (1948-....) (United Kingdom, before 1980).
rows.Bloom: Yellow blend, pink edges. Mild fragrance. Average diameter 4.5". Large, double (17-25 petals), exhibition bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit: Height: 30" to 5' (75 to 150cm). Width: up to 2' (up to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Notes: Named for the British periodical.Fryer's Roses says The Lady is one of their most popular Hybrid Teas. The colour of the classically shaped and highly scented blossoms is a soft, delicate honey, edged with a hint of salmon. This rose won a Gold Medal in Baden-Baden and a Trial Ground Certificate from the Royal National Rose Society...
